races.paceDynamic: Tap Tap Shamie will take them along from the front with no other confirmed pace angles, creating a sustainable rhythm that won't stretch the field early. The hold-up horses (Mickthesoldier, Colinski, Palavar) will need to rely on Hashtag Queen providing some pace pressure or tactical positioning from her prominent style. With limited early pace beyond the leader, this sets up as a steady gallop that builds from the back of the last flight. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent runners who can avoid getting caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Tap Tap Shamie gets an easy lead without pressure from Hashtag Queen.
scenarios.body: The proven hurdler dictates terms throughout and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges. His class advantage over this modest field becomes decisive when he's allowed to control the tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Hashtag Queen travels well and applies pace pressure to the leader.
scenarios.body: The mare's early positioning allows her to stay out of trouble while the hold-up horses get caught behind a slowly-run race. She can capitalize on any weakening of the leader in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rallies
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: Colinski's flat speed comes into play in a tactical finish where his superior turn of foot can overwhelm the pace-setters. The ex-flat winner benefits from his class dropping back to novice level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the main fancies underperform and gaps appear late.
scenarios.body: Rachel Lopez or Mickthesoldier finds significant improvement on their recent efforts. The small field and lack of pace allows an unfancied runner to steal a march.

watchPoints.text: Tap Tap Shamie could get an uncontested lead that makes him very hard to peg back given his class edge
Hashtag Queen's early positioning will be crucial - if she settles too far back the pace could collapse completely
Colinski showed ability on the flat and could be overpriced if adapting quickly to hurdles on debut
The pace could be pedestrian with only one confirmed front-runner, potentially setting up a sprint finish
Rachel Lopez making both stable and hurdles debut creates uncertainty about her true ability level

races.paceDynamic: V Twelve is the lone confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. Zero Tolerance and Beat The Edge can track prominently but aren't natural pace-forcers, leaving V Twelve relatively uncontested through the early stages. The majority of this field are hold-up horses including We Got Your Back, Ghasham, Conquer The Breeze, and Natural Ability, creating a bunched field that will need to organize late. This tactical setup strongly favors prominent runners and front runners who can capitalize on the lack of early pace pressure and gain crucial jumping room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If V Twelve jumps cleanly and maintains rhythm without early interference
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows V Twelve to dictate ideal fractions while the hold-up brigade gets shuffled back. Prominent trackers Zero Tolerance and Beat The Edge are best positioned to capitalize if the leader falters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes overly pedestrian and bunches the field at the business end
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with a sprint finish developing from the last fence. Natural Ability and We Got Your Back have shown best recent chase form to exploit this setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If V Twelve fails to maintain gallop or makes jumping errors when pressured
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear pace anchor, suiting adaptable types who can quicken. Beat The Edge's lower weight and Zero Tolerance's consistent placing record become crucial assets.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the tactical nature or jumping demands
scenarios.body: Course specialist form or trainer improvements come to the fore in a wide-open finish. Conquer The Breeze's C&D win and Ghasham's yard switch could prove decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: V Twelve's jumping under pressure given the 190-day layoff and need to sustain gallop
Beat The Edge and Alice Stevens 3lb claim could be underestimated at bottom weight
Natural Ability's last-to-first running style needs gaps to appear in home straight
Zero Tolerance seeking first win in 16 attempts but has placed consistently in chases
Conquer The Breeze's yard switch to Adam Nicol after 132-day break requires market confidence

races.paceDynamic: Betterforeveryone will lead from the start with his proven front-running style, likely joined or tracked closely by the prominent racers Hostile Hotelier, Jet Legs, No Regrets and Court At Slip through the early stages. This creates a solid but not breakneck gallop over 3m, with the hold-up horses Gold Clermont, You Some Girl and Eaton Anne needing to navigate through traffic in the home straight. The sustained pace over this stamina test will suit prominent racers who can track the leader without getting into a speed duel, while the hold-up horses face the tactical disadvantage of relying on others to falter.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers can sit close to Betterforeveryone without pressuring him early
scenarios.body: The pace stays honest but not destructive, allowing a well-positioned tracker to challenge approaching the final fence when Betterforeveryone begins to tire. This suits horses with tactical speed who don't need to make ground from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Wire-to-Wire Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Betterforeveryone gets an easy lead and the prominent pack doesn't apply enough pressure
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets into a rhythm and has enough left to repel late challenges, using his stamina advantage over the 3m trip. His 73-day break and proven course form become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong between Betterforeveryone and his prominent pursuers
scenarios.body: The leaders come back to the field in the final half-mile, allowing a patient rider to time their challenge perfectly from off the pace. This rewards horses with a strong finishing kick who can weave through tired horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Betterforeveryone gets an uncontested lead and the field becomes strung out early
scenarios.body: The race becomes a procession with little pressure throughout, favouring whichever horse has the most natural stamina regardless of tactics. The winner comes from those who can sustain their effort longest.

watchPoints.text: Betterforeveryone could get an uncontested lead if the prominent horses are too respectful early, making him very hard to peg back
Gold Clermont's hold-up style requires others to go fast enough early to bring him into contention, but this pace may not materialize
Hostile Hotelier's 106-day layoff could see him needing the run despite his class edge on these ratings
The hold-up horses You Some Girl and Eaton Anne both have headgear changes and may need luck in running to get competitive
Court At Slip's recent pull-up over 4m here suggests either the distance was too far or he has an issue to prove wrong

races.paceDynamic: Peaceinthevalley will set the early pace from his prominent position, but with no other confirmed front-runners pressuring him, this will develop into a steady, sustainable gallop over the 3m trip. Eastern Storm, Line Em Up, Sunset On Fire and Imperial Imp will all need cover from their hold-up styles, creating a cluster behind the leaders. The lack of pace pressure means the race will likely be decided by a staying battle from the final half-mile. This measured tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a late kick, as the early pace won't be strong enough to set up the prominent runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady throughout with Peaceinthevalley unopposed early
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows hold-up horses to get into perfect rhythm and unleash finishing kicks that the pace-setters cannot match. Eastern Storm's point-to-point winning streak and Line Em Up's unbeaten record become decisive factors in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Steal It
scenarios.trigger: If Eagles Rock or Second Subaltern press Peaceinthevalley earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased early pace stretches the hold-up horses and creates gaps they cannot close, allowing the prominent runners to maintain their advantage. Eagles Rock's recent Kelso form and quick return gives him the fitness edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Peaceinthevalley goes too slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery sprint with positioning crucial, favouring horses with tactical speed regardless of running style. The most balanced performers who can adapt quickest benefit from the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Peaceinthevalley maintains his lead throughout without serious challenge
scenarios.body: His consistent gallop proves too much for the hold-up horses to peg back over the extended trip. The lack of early competition allows him to dictate terms and keep enough in reserve.

watchPoints.text: Eastern Storm's fitness after 364 days off - if sharp early could be unbeatable but if rusty will struggle
Line Em Up's adaptation to hunter chasing rules on debut - pointing form excellent but different demands
Peaceinthevalley's early pace setting - if too generous could set up hold-up horses perfectly
Eagles Rock's quick turnaround from Wednesday's Kelso run - fitness edge or too soon question
Weather conditions affecting good going - any softening would suit Second Subaltern's pointing form

runners_data.comment: Hurdle winner in France; close second at Sedgefield in November but hasn't run since
runners_data.spotlight: Won over hurdles in France (2m3f, heavy); some fair form since joining Micky Hammond and was a close second at Sedgefield in November (2m4f, soft) but hasn't run since.

runners_data.name: Perseus Way
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with recent course run but lack of hurdles experience at this level
runners_data.comment: Good 3rd after a break over 2m here last week; should improve on that; longer trip a worry
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Hamilton handicap for Stuart Coltherd in September (1m5f, good to soft); subsequently changed yards and promising third over 2m here on stable debut after a break last week (good); should improve on that but yet to prove he is as effective at this trip.

races.paceDynamic: The Four Sixes and Johnson's Blue are confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, with Lawrenny and Gardener likely to race prominently just behind them. This honest gallop over 2m4f will create a demanding test, particularly with multiple hurdles to navigate. The sustained pace will expose any fitness doubts and favor horses that can travel strongly in the middle stages before finishing. This race shape clearly favors prominent racers and hold-up horses with tactical speed, as the genuine early pace will set up a finish where closing kicks matter most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Gallop Suits
scenarios.trigger: If The Four Sixes and Johnson's Blue establish a solid early tempo without going too fast.
scenarios.body: The sustained but manageable pace allows closers to get into contention while stretching the stamina of weaker stayers. Hold-up horses like Imperial Data and Saracen Beau can time their challenges perfectly off this rhythm.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners go too hard early trying to dominate each other.
scenarios.body: The pace duel burns out the leaders in the final half-mile, creating opportunities for prominent racers who avoided the early battle. Gardener and Lawrenny can capitalize from their forward positions without being compromised.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If The Four Sixes gets an easy lead and dictates terms throughout.
scenarios.body: Without serious early pressure, the leader can control fractions and prove too strong late despite the drop in grade concerns. Johnson's Blue stays on for minor honors having tracked the winner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Early Becomes Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders respect each other too much and crawl through early stages.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a sprint finish where the best handicapped horses with tactical speed can strike. Perseus Way and Monaco Rules benefit from the lack of genuine test of stamina.

watchPoints.text: Johnson's Blue was pulled up at Haydock last time and may not handle the early pace battle
Imperial Data has been off for 216 days and may need this run despite his obvious class advantage
The Four Sixes has been disappointing over hurdles recently and the two confirmed leaders could compromise each other
Gardener is attempting a course hat-trick off a 9lb higher mark but has solid recent form
Dare To Shout returns to hurdles after chase campaign with stable debut for Ann Hamilton

races.name: Jenni's Justatenner 50th Celebrations Handicap Hurdle (Div I)

runners_data.name: Scots Poet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with good recent form including Sedgefield win, now wears blinkers and rises 4lb but has the class to overcome
runners_data.comment: Off the mark for 2026 at Sedgefield last time; could go well off this 4lb higher mark
runners_data.spotlight: Mainly in good form this year, gaining a well-deserved win at Sedgefield last time (2m1f, good; blinkers on for fourth time); up 4lb; could go well again.

runners_data.name: Gemini Man
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer who won at this course and distance last year, versatile on Flat and hurdles with solid recent form
runners_data.comment: C&D winner last August; some good runs over hurdles and on the Flat since; chance
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner off 6lb lower last August (good); some sound runs since, both over hurdles and on the Flat (9.4f Wolverhampton winner in February); chance.

runners_data.name: Ms Cindy Kate
runners_data.note: Promising mare moving to handicaps after decent fourth at Carlisle, likely to improve from that experience with hold-up style suiting
runners_data.comment: Unexposed; fair 4th in Carlisle novice last time and improvement expected now handicapping
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed mare who shaped with promise when a running-on fourth in a Carlisle novice last time (2m1f, good to soft); improvement likely now going handicapping.

runners_data.name: Clean Getaway
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from Philip Kirby yard with good course form, carries penalty but track specialist who handles good ground well

runners_data.name: Kellie's Dream
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well-handicapped after 10lb drop, returns after 77-day break but previous Irish wins came on softer ground
runners_data.comment: Dual winner on softish going; down 10lb for three poor runs last term; back after wind op
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins in Ireland, both with give in the ground; has become well handicapped after being dropped 10lb for three poor runs last season; interesting back after wind surgery.

runners_data.name: Alvesta
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse and 30-race maiden making second start for new yard, bought cheaply but should improve for Kelso debut run
runners_data.comment: 0-30 Flat and jumps; 3,400gns buy; beaten 34l on stable debut; should improve; good mark
runners_data.spotlight: 30-race maiden Flat and jumps; bought for 3,400gns in February; well beaten on stable debut at Kelso last month (2m2f, good); should improve for that run; on a good mark at present.

runners_data.name: Malangen
runners_data.note: Only front runner in field, 11-year-old course winner who should improve for recent Perth reappearance after 16-day gap
runners_data.comment: 10-82, including C&D win in June 2024; should be all the better for last run; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Has won ten of his 82 races, including over this C&D in June 2024 (good); should be all the better for last month's reappearance run at Perth; interesting.

runners_data.name: Linden Lane
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse still seeking first hurdles win but showed promise in recent handicaps, returns after 78-day absence
runners_data.comment: Creditable 3rd in two handicaps in the winter; lesser run on heavy latest; each-way chance
runners_data.spotlight: 0-11 over hurdles; third in handicaps at Windsor in January (2m, good) and Sedgefield in February (2m1f, good to soft); can be forgiven lesser effort on testing ground last time; each-way chance.

runners_data.name: King Sacre
runners_data.note: Improving hold-up horse who ran career-best second at Sedgefield on handicap debut, unexposed type with more to offer
runners_data.comment: Unexposed; improved form when second on h'cap debut at Sedgefield last time; a possible
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed; showed improved form on handicap debut when second at Sedgefield last time (2m1f, good); further progress likely; a possible.

runners_data.name: Walk On Son
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from strong yard but carries warning after recent fading finishes, needs to prove stamina at this trip
runners_data.comment: Third in a 2m1f novice in October; below-par this year, including on h'cap debut (2m4f)
runners_data.spotlight: Ordinary form in bumpers; has improved since going hurdling, best run when third in a Carlisle novice in October (2m1f, good); bit disappointing this year, including on handicap debut on first run after a second wind op last time (2m4f, good); bit to prove now.

runners_data.name: Mr Globalist
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who is 37-race maiden, ran in selling hurdle here seven days ago so quick turnaround raises questions
runners_data.comment: 37-race maiden Flat and jumps; well beaten in conditions seller last week; plenty to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to win in 37 runs Flat and jumps; beaten a long way in a non-handicap C&D selling hurdle last week; has more of a chance here, but plenty to prove.

races.paceDynamic: Malangen is the lone confirmed front runner and will be allowed to set a steady, uncontested pace through the early stages. Clean Getaway and Mr Globalist can sit prominent but are unlikely to challenge the leader early, creating a pedestrian gallop. The race will develop into a sprint finish as the large contingent of hold-up horses - including Scots Poet, Gemini Man, King Sacre, and Linden Lane - launch their challenges from mid-division. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they'll have plenty of horse left when the pace quickens in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Malangen maintains a steady rhythm without serious early pressure from Clean Getaway or Mr Globalist.
scenarios.body: The veteran gets into an ideal rhythm and proves hard to peg back despite the strong finishers behind. His course and distance win last year shows he can handle this exact tactical scenario when allowed to dictate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian allowing the better-rated hold-up horses to unleash decisive finishing kicks.
scenarios.body: Scots Poet and Gemini Man have the class edge in this field and both excel when getting racing late. Their superior ratings tell when the race becomes a pure test of acceleration from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Handicapper Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If King Sacre or Ms Cindy Kate can find another gear of improvement from their recent promising efforts.
scenarios.body: Both horses showed encouraging signs last time and could have more in the tank than their current ratings suggest. The tactical setup plays perfectly to their hold-up styles and neither has reached their ceiling yet.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Clean Getaway can track Malangen closely then find more than the leader in the final furlong.
scenarios.body: The Philip Kirby runner gets the best of both worlds - saving ground behind the leader but close enough to strike when Malangen weakens. His recent Sedgefield win shows he has the finishing kick to capitalize on ideal positioning.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early pressure on Malangen from Clean Getaway as any pace injection will compromise the leader's stamina reserves
Monitor King Sacre's position turning for home as his recent improvement suggests he could find another gear if produced with winning chance
Keep eye on Scots Poet's blinkers impact in closing stages as headgear has been positive factor in recent runs including last win
Watch Walk On Son for any signs of stamina failure in final furlong given his recent tendency to fade when pressure applied
Observe how quickly Gemini Man is produced by Joshua Thompson as timing will be crucial given his hold-up style and class edge

runners_data.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who rebounded from disappointing handicap debut when clear second to progressive rival at Uttoxeter (2m, soft) in November and was also running well before penultimate-flight fall at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) in February; one to consider.

runners_data.spotlight: Very lightly raced 8yo who returned from a layoff to open account at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) in February 2025; not seen since but may still have potential and can evidently go well when fresh.

runners_data.name: My My My Delilah
runners_data.note: Only pace-setter who will control tempo unchallenged but remains winless over hurdles in seven attempts
runners_data.comment: 0-7 over hurdles but ran well and suggested her turn might be near over C&D last month
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles but ran well and suggested her turn might be near when close fourth behind Snapaudaciaheros over C&D (good) last month, and won't mind if the ground is slower today; could be the answer.

runners_data.name: Breadalbane Lass
runners_data.note: Recent maiden winner at Perth who faces 8lb rise but carries useful tongue-tie and cheekpieces combination

runners_data.name: Mornington Beach

runners_data.name: National Question

runners_data.name: Mythical

runners_data.spotlight: Smart on the Flat in his prime but struggled off lowly mark on stable/handicap hurdle debut in March (3m1f); may benefit from this steep drop back in trip but still has too much to prove.

races.paceDynamic: My My My Delilah is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gate, likely to get an uncontested lead with most rivals preferring to settle. With nine hold-up horses behind her, this creates a classic scenario where the pace-setter controls the tempo without early pressure. The large pack of hold-up horses will create traffic problems and a frantic finish as they all try to make their moves simultaneously. This race shape strongly favours early pace and prominent runners who can avoid the inevitable late scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If My My My Delilah gets easy fractions and isn't pressed early
scenarios.body: She controls every call while the hold-up brigade gets bunched up behind, creating the perfect scenario for the leader to kick clear. The lack of early pace pressure allows her to save energy for a decisive move entering the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the nine hold-up horses create a bunched finish with multiple hard-luck stories
scenarios.body: The large group of similar-styled runners leads to interference and blocked passages, allowing the best jumper or luckiest horse to prevail. Late splits and jockey skill become decisive factors in the final furlong scramble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If My My My Delilah goes too slow early and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: The uncontested lead becomes a liability as she sets pedestrian fractions, allowing the entire field to close en masse. Superior class and finishing speed triumph over tactical positioning in a bunched finale.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Speed Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If another horse unexpectedly goes forward to challenge My My My Delilah early
scenarios.body: An unexpected pace duel develops when a supposed hold-up horse tracks closer than expected, creating faster fractions. This sets up perfectly for the best closer with tactical speed to strike late.

watchPoints.text: My My My Delilah could steal this if allowed uncontested lead given nine hold-up horses behind her
Traffic problems inevitable with nine similar hold-up runners all needing room in home straight
Amateur jockeys on Two Auld Pals and Hourless claiming significant weight but potentially short of race-riding experience
The Best Way showing 441 days since last run which creates major fitness concerns despite previous win
Snapaudaciaheros and My My My Delilah both ran over course and distance 26 days ago with contrasting results
